task_snapshots.title: Implement semantic tokens (LSP semanticTokensProvider)
task_snapshots.description:
## Goal
Implement LSP semantic tokens for apexls-server, per the spec at `.scratch/apex-lsp-gaps/issues/01-semantic-tokens-implement.md` (produced by task `d416253d0c47`, listed in `depends_on`). Do not start until that file exists -- the spec pins the token-type/modifier mapping, legend order, and edge-case rules; deviating silently will fail review.

## Deliverables (all three must land in one commit series)
1. **`crates/apexls-server/src/capabilities.rs`** -- add two `pub(crate)` functions, matching the file's existing per-feature-function convention (see e.g. `folding_ranges` at line 703 and `document_symbols` at line 463):
   - `pub(crate) fn semantic_tokens_full(program: &BoundProgram, file: FileId, encoding: PositionEncoding) -> SemanticTokens`
   - `pub(crate) fn semantic_tokens_range(program: &BoundProgram, file: FileId, range: TextRange, encoding: PositionEncoding) -> SemanticTokens`
   Both walk the file's CST (`apex_syntax`) once, emit a token per identifier-shaped syntax node whose classification the spec covers, and produce LSP-delta-encoded output. Position encoding must go through `line_index::PositionEncoding` -- do NOT hand-encode UTF-16 offsets. Use the `SymbolTable` for declaration-site classifications and `ReferenceTable::get` for reference-site classifications. If a node has no resolution (e.g. syntax error), skip emitting a token for it rather than emitting one with the wrong type -- matching the spec's `Unresolved` rule.
2. **`crates/apexls-server/src/lib.rs`** -- three changes:
   - Add a `semantic_tokens_provider` field to the `ServerCapabilities` block in `Backend::initialize` (currently `lib.rs:659-758`), using `SemanticTokensServerCapabilities::SemanticTokensOptions` with the legend and `full: Some(SemanticTokensFullOptions::Bool(true))`, `range: Some(true)`, `work_done_progress_options: Default::default()`. The legend's `token_types`/`token_modifiers` arrays must match the spec exactly and be defined as a `const` (or `LazyLock`) so both the capability declaration and the emit-side type-index lookup share one source of truth.
   - Add `async fn semantic_tokens_full(&mut self, params: SemanticTokensParams) -> ...` and `async fn semantic_tokens_range(&mut self, params: SemanticTokensRangeParams) -> ...` to the `LanguageServer` impl, following the exact snapshot + `wait_for_rebuild(version).await` + `bind.program` pattern that `Backend::document_symbol` (line 1250) and `Backend::folding_range` (line 1299) already use. Return `Ok(Some(SemanticTokensResult::Tokens(...)))` on success, `Ok(None)` if the file is unknown.
3. **`crates/apexls-server/tests/semantic_tokens.rs`** -- new integration-test file. Match the style of `tests/document_symbol*.rs` and `tests/folding_range*.rs` (skim one first). At least one `#[tokio::test]` per major classification: class decl, method decl, field decl, parameter, local var, static call to a project-local class, stdlib call (e.g. `System.debug`), unresolved reference. Also: a `_range` test that clips output to a subrange of the file. Assert the actual (line, char, len, type, modifiers) tuples decoded from `SemanticTokens::data` -- do NOT snapshot the raw encoded array; the diff on failure will be unreadable.

## Constraints
- No changes to any `apex-binder`/`apex-parser`/`apex-syntax`/`apex-stdlib` crate -- the research (`.scratch/apex-lsp-gaps/research.md`, synthesis item 1) is explicit that no new binder work is needed; if you feel like you need to add a binder field, stop and re-read the spec instead.
- No new workspace dependencies -- `lsp-types = 0.95.0` (already in `crates/apexls-server/Cargo.toml`) re-exports every semantic-tokens type you need.
- Delta (`textDocument/semanticTokens/full/delta`) is EXPLICITLY out of scope for v1. Do not implement `semantic_tokens_full_delta`. The spec calls this out as a follow-up.
- No dynamic registration; capabilities are declared statically in `initialize` like every other feature in this crate.

## Validation before marking complete
All of these must pass locally, from repo root:
- `cargo build -p apexls-server` (the primary compile gate)
- `cargo test -p apexls-server --test semantic_tokens -- --nocapture` (this task's new integration tests)
- `cargo test -p apexls-server` (regression: no other test file breaks -- if one does, that's a real bug in the wiring, don't disable it)
- `cargo clippy -p apexls-server -- -D warnings` if the repo uses it (check first with `git grep clippy .cargo/`)

## Context hints
- Snapshot + wait_for_rebuild pattern: `Backend::document_symbol` at `crates/apexls-server/src/lib.rs:1250-1273` is the closest existing shape to copy from.
- Per-capability function convention: every `pub(crate) fn` in `crates/apexls-server/src/capabilities.rs` takes `&BoundProgram` and `FileId`, and returns the plain `lsp-types` return shape (not a `Result`) -- errors bubble via `Option::None` or empty vecs. Keep this convention.
- `line_index::PositionEncoding` in `crates/apexls-server/src/line_index.rs` already handles UTF-8/16/32 line/column conversion; use its existing methods, don't reinvent.
- Binder data sources: `BoundProgram::symbol(SymbolId) -> &Symbol` gives you kind + modifiers; `program.reference_table_for(file).get(SyntaxPtr)` gives you `Resolution` -- both already used all over `capabilities.rs` (grep for `references_to` and `resolution_at`).
- Test-file style: existing tests build a `Backend` in-process via `binder_integration.rs` helpers -- reuse that infrastructure rather than spawning a real subprocess.

## When done
1. `git add -A && git commit -m "feat: LSP semantic tokens (ticket 01)"`
2. `bernstein task complete <this-task-id> --summary "Implemented semantic tokens with tests."`
